The description incorrectly states that the "Consistency-CE" line ends at AL=8. The plot shows its final data point is at AL≈8.5. This error is repeated for the other two lines, which are also incorrectly said to end at AL=8.
The description states the final point for "Consistency-Uni" has a BLEU score of approximately 31.9. In the plot, the final point (at AL≈8.5) has a BLEU score of approximately 32.4.
